'''Thornwisp''' is a [[Grass]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Snapshade]] at 18 stars, and evolves into [[Chomperwraith]] at 36 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Thornwisp loves to cast a menacing shadow, taking pleasure in watching Tatari get scared and scatter. But on cold nights, Thornwisp will secretly extend branches to shield sleeping Tatari from the wind."

Thornwisp is a red rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
TBA

== Evolution Trial ==
Thornwisp's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 36 stars. To evolve it into [[Chomperwraith]] you need to complete the following three tasks:

* Feed this Tatari to B quality.
* Shoot 60,000 pinballs.
* Feed Thornwisp any 120 food items.

== Trivia ==
* Thornwisp and its evolutions were added to the game on 7/29/2026 alongside [[Kaiseroo]] and [[Saberheart]].
